steps.text: Oof... This is just the right temperature. Hot springs are fun, but the temperature's a tad bit too peaceful.
This temperature keeps my head clear. Helps me think about the real important questions.

spans.text: temperature keeps my head clear. Helps me think about the real important questions.

steps.text: Say... Which did the planet birth first? Lava or rocks?

Let's start from the very beginning. 'Lava' wasn't 'lava,' and 'rock' wasn't 'rock.' All thing are a cycle, and they take different shapes during their changes, and so they were given different names.

Man is always trying to use assertive language to delimit the indescribable natures of the world, almost like it's the only way they can get a good night's sleep. This, too, goes to show their lack of wisdom...
Hey, watch out there. Don't splash all that lava everywhere. It's dangerous. It's not that likely, but what if someone just happens to walk by—

spans.text: Hey, watch out there. Don't splash all that lava everywhere. It's dangerous. It's not
likely, but what if someone just happens to walk by—

steps.text: Hm? What's with the ruckus... Is somebody trying to join us?

The enormous monster beneath their feet is breathing heavier and heavier by the second. The temperature in their surroundings has risen quite a bit. The lava spewed out from the volcano's crater rapidly cools and turns into rocks that come rolling down.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Kahn, Professor Keller... This place is dangerous... We should leave...

steps.name: Kahn
steps.text: Adele, you get out of here first. This is something that I need to settle with her, right here and now!

steps.name: Keller
steps.text: Kahn, don't be absurd!

steps.name: Kahn
steps.text: When you left them there on Mount Unna, what they had to face was much worse!

steps.name: Kahn
steps.text: Do you even have a conscience? Is admitting to what you've done harder than facing death?!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Kahn... We need to hurry...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I won't be able to block the next wave...

steps.name: Kahn
steps.text: Watch out! Behind you!
Adele lifts her staff, but the rocks are falling like rain. Her Originium Arts are unable to melt all of them down.
She focuses on protecting her allies, yet she can't hear their warnings or the sound of the danger behind her.

steps.name: Dejected Little Girl
steps.text: I saw you the past few days, but it looks like nobody else can.

steps.name: Dejected Little Girl
steps.text: I don't know where you came from, but you're the only one who's willing to hang out with me. I know, you like strawberry ice cream, too, right?

steps.name: Cheerful Creature
steps.text: (Lies down obediently)

steps.name: Dejected Little Girl
steps.text: Look, our home used to be right under that volcano there, but it's going to go away soon.

steps.name: Dejected Little Girl
steps.text: I actually know... I was abandoned there, and Harley and Enis found me.

steps.name: Dejected Little Girl
steps.text: I don't know why I was abandoned, but if my real parents ever come looking for me, will they still be able to find me?

steps.name: Dejected Little Girl
steps.text: *sigh*... Daddy is gone, and Enis is leaving. Little lamb, where do you think our home really is? Where is the friend who ate strawberry ice cream with me a long time ago?

steps.name: Cheerful Creature
steps.text: (Unsatisfied groan)

steps.name: Dejected Little Girl
steps.text: Hey—
The ocean doesn't answer her. It merely sits between the two Siestas as always.
Suddenly, the girl notices that the calm, quiet shoreline has gotten closer to her at some point. The seawater gradually drowned the dry surface and has reached her feet.

steps.name: Dejected Little Girl
steps.text: Hmm...?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Liv!
Their surroundings suddenly fall silent.
The bubbling lava, the falling rocks. All of it are suddenly without sound whatsoever, as though time itself has ground to a halt.

Adele isn't sure if it is her hearing aids that have failed or that she has once again fallen into a dream. All she can feel is that she is enveloped by a formless warmth, as though she has fallen into a cozy mattress.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Poor little one, you seem to be frightened. *sigh*, why did you climb the volcano at a time like this?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mr. Dolly? So this is where you've been!

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I thought you'd left... Where are Keller and Kahn?! Did the lambs cause the volcanic anomaly? I... Am I already dead...?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Hey, hey! Calm down, little one. I know you have a lot of questions, but slow down. We'll take it one step at a time.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: You are alive and well, and so are your buddies, but I won't let them see me. Once they wake up from this, all they'll think is that they had a nice little nap.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: As for all that strange equipment on the volcano... Terribly sorry. I told them to be extra careful—I'm not lying this time!

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: But I wasn't able to keep them in check. They were being so rowdy with their fun... And I'm not lying about this, either.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Having fun... on a volcano?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Of course! Didn't I tell you? This is second best thing on the planet! Volcano surfing!

Adele lifts her head up and looks into the distance. There is lava gushing out of the crater sporadically, but she can faintly make out silhouettes of critters enjoying themselves. At the same time, there are many more creatures happily making their way toward the crater.
The mountain is covered in a blanket of white wool, almost like clouds have come falling down from the sky and draped themselves over it.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mr. Dolly, these sheep aren't just your clones, are they...?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Ohh? You've realized it, have you?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Just as I said, I've met a lot of interesting folk during the long, long time I've been around.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Oh, don't get the wrong idea. They aren't 'souls' or anything.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: There's no way to keep lives that have been lost. I simply copied how they looked and made all these little ones... It's like... a personal collection? I thought you'd like them.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: That sounds... kind of cruel...

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Look at me talking on and on. I only just noticed that you've found the fur too. Yeah... it's been way too long since the last time I saw them.
Just then, another scar appears on her old, tattered protective gear.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I should've guessed.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: It's an apt metaphor, isn't it? Animals need very thick fur to protect themselves—same for humans.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: When I see you standing here like that, it's like I'm looking at those two old friends of mine. I really miss them.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Oh, you earn no praise from me for inheriting their exquisite mantle. It's just I'm guessing you miss them too. Poor girl, why can't you just open up and admit it?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: No need to act tough. You shouldn't keep yourself so on edge, either. No one will deny a girl your age the right to feel sad or afraid. You need to learn to not act tough.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: If you're tired, stop and take a break or cry your heart out.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mr. Dolly, is this scavenger hunt just a game?

spans.text: Mr. Dolly, is this scavenger hunt

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: It's true that it's not really all that mysterious of a puzzle. I just wanted you to have some fun, Adele.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: I had lots of fun during my time in Siesta.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I don't understand. Why are you taking such good care of me in particular...?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: It's simple. A girl as lovely as you is a rare sight on this world.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Misfortune may find you often... but you have no less love than anybody else.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Actually, I saw you a long time ago, back in Leithanien.
A little girl always earnestly reading her books in that tiny, little spire.
As the child of two genius academics, many had high expectations of her. She was seen as a gifted Caster and scholar.

Outstanding, remarkably talented individuals like her are always burdened with achieving results to match their talent. Even if they are inflicted with an incurable disease, they are seen by others as a tenacious role model.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Young Adele, has anyone ever asked you what you wanted?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Take a look. There are so many people and so many lives all around the world. You know volcanoes like the back of your hoof, but there are so many fun things out there besides volcanoes. Why not see for yourself?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Thanks... Mr. Dolly. I've... had a lot of fun these past few days...

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: I can smell half a lie. Just half, but we'll leave it like this for now.

spans.text: a lie. Just half, but we'll leave it like this for now.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: It's nearly time. I really wanted to invite you to come try lava surfing with me, but the human body is too weak.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: I'll take you three somewhere safe. Then, I'll have to be ready for the opening of Volcano Paradise.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: So long, Adele.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Thanks, Mr. Dolly... Will we meet again?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Perhaps... No, maybe I should say we will meet again for sure.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: I hope that the next time we meet, I will get to see a truly happy Adele.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Promise me this?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Yeah!
The fluffy creature shakes its body a little, walks forward a few steps, and lightly brushes the girl's cheek with its snout.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Oh! I almost forgot. I owe you a reward for finding all three things.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Mr. Dolly, do you know anything else about... the death of my parents?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Hrmm...

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: What I mean is... The thing you've been looking for... isn't 'Volcano Watchers?'

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: You've been talking about Volcano Watchers?!

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: S-Surprise...?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I thought...

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: There used to be a lot of Volcano Watchers growing on Mount Siesta's hills. They look pretty, and they are tasty. That's why the little ones ate most of them up.

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Then I realized if they kept on eating them, it wouldn't be long before they went extinct. That's why I planted some of them in a secret spot behind their backs.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: So the Volcano Watchers aren't extinct yet... That's good news...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Then where did you plant the flowers?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Oh, just on top of a hill around the back of the volcano.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: By volcano... You mean this one, the one that's about to erupt...?

steps.name: Dolly
steps.text: Er... yeah.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Enis?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Are you... leaving...?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Out of breath)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Why did you... run out here all by yourself...?

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: I thought... you weren't ever going to come back.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Are you kidding me...?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: When you're on the adventure team... you never work alone.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Let's go home.
The seawater has risen above their soles, making it difficult to even walk.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Hurry!
At first, the waves were just a hazy line at the far reach of their vision, but in just the blink of an eye, they are right here in front of them.
Enis tightly clutches his sister as the waves beat against his less than robust back, causing him to stagger.
Another, taller wave is approaching them.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (There's no way...)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: (Let's try this—)
Enis tries his hardest to feel the 'rock' in his body. It's close to his heart. Every time his heart beats, he can feel its hard texture.
A rock the size of a man rises from the ground in front of the siblings and immediately crumbles just barely withstanding the crashing of the wave.
There is an intense pain in his chest.

steps.name: Girl
steps.text: Enis!

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Look... Didn't I tell you...? I know magic...
Enis wipes the blood on his face and pulls his sister so she isn't hurt by the crumbling gravel.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Quick, hide behind me!
One, two...
Seemingly formed by the white waves, a countless number of fluffy creatures rush toward them from the coast. They stack together and form a wall, or more precisely, a dam.
The waves clash against the furry dam, completely absorbed by it the very next second.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I must've gone crazy...

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: What exactly is this...?
Having absorbed the seawater, their white wool has grown even puffier, enough to keep the siblings safe from the dangerous waves.
After who knows how long, the ground has finally stopped shaking, and the waves gradually start to calm.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Are... Are we saved?

steps.name: Dozy Creature
steps.text: (Shivers) (Shakes to dry body)

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Th-Thank you...?

steps.name: Dozy Creature
steps.text: (Happy bleat)
Just like cotton candy dissolving in the water, the beastling suddenly disappears.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: I guess that's... a near-death hallucination...?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Enis!
The night deepens, and at some point in time, the bustling crowd's clamor gradually started to fade.
Someone has taken out a guitar and started playing a gentle melody.
Almost like some kind of tacit understanding, everyone looks in the same direction.
A pillar of smoke gradually rises from the volcano's caldera, followed by spews of dark red and ash gray. The ground is trembling slightly underneath their feet.

steps.name: Perturbed Passerby
steps.text: We're so far out. We definitely won't get caught in that, right...?

steps.name: Regretful Passerby
steps.text: *sigh*... It still came.

steps.name: Male Instrument Shop Owner
steps.text: Oh... It really erupted...
The people in the crowd hold the hands of those around them. Parents hug their children tight, as pedestrians begin to hold their breaths.

As though they all finally feel a weight off their shoulders, or perhaps like a giant boulder has finally crushed their hearts, sighs and quiet mumblings can be heard amongst the crowd, yet this just makes the whole street seem even more quiet.
This continues for a very, very long time, until the crowd snaps back from the sight before them.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: I can still recall that back when I was a young boy... my parents would take me to this little hill. It was full of flowers and trees whose names I never knew. There were so many of them, and they smelled so wonderful every spring.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: My father was allergic to their pollen, so he would wait for us at the bottom of the hill. My mother and I would bend the flowers' branches and weave garlands. We ran and ran across the hill, and waved down to the bottom of the hill...

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: ...That won't ever happen again...

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Mr. Tom...

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: It's nothing, girl. I'm just thinking about the past... I used to sell ice cream every day, meeting all kinds of children.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Now my children are all in Columbia. They didn't come back home, even for a time like this.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sir, your children are far away. It's possible that they didn't know Siesta's volcano was going to erupt today. The might be on their way, or they could have a package still in transit...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I came here because I wanted to build a logistics center that connected all regions and shortened the distances between them.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Maybe someday, you'll get things from different places more quickly, and your children will know how you're doing that much faster.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But we're still a long way away from achieving that... Just now, I was thinking that I might be able to do something to help...

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: What's that...?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: If anyone needs to send a postcard to family abroad, Mountaincomm Trade could deliver them for free the next few days.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: By the time they get them, or when they come back after they get their postcards, Siesta will be a better place than it is now.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'll do my best to make this a better place, too. It's a small wish of mine, aside from my commercial ambitions.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Thanks, kid.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: It's such a nice thing to be able to write your family...

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: When I was studying in Columbia, I would sometimes get homesick at night. I always wanted to write home, but I couldn't afford international postage, so all I ever did was cry myself to sleep...

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: That's when I'd remember a poem that means something like, wheresoever someone is, the twin moons in the night sky are always the same, and if we look at the moons, even the greatest distances are nothing.

steps.name: Snowsant
steps.text: Does Siesta have any songs like that...?
The old man clears his throat. His beard slightly twitches, as though he remembers something, and starts singing a song stiltedly.
The volcanic ash slowly spreads, covering half the sky.

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: Each day I linger, aside my dreams ♪
I've lost my way, I'm a fowl without wings ♪
I grasp at hope, I'm holdin' on out ♪
Oh on the road, will I come tumblin' down ♪
And maybe somethin' scares in me, if tomorrow's sun I see ♪
But I'm just headin' far, I'm no wanderer ♪

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: ...I'm just headin' far, I'm no wanderer ♪

steps.name: Cold Drinks Shop Owner
steps.text: 'Cause right out there... I've been lookin' to be ♪
Lady Ceylon.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Schwarz! What are you doing here?!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I had a few missions for Rhodes Island, but I came as soon as I was finished with them.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It took me forever to find you. I'd been searching the crowd for the better part of the day. I have your favorite tea in my bag. I'll give it to you as soon as we get back.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: And... I also wanted to come back...
They see the rocks in their memories crumble, as a magnificent evening glow they had never before seen rises from the top of the volcano.

A pink smoke covers half of the sky and gradually flutters downward toward the ground. Although they did not see it for themselves, they know a memory that belonged only to them has now been forever buried underneath the white volcanic ash.

steps.name: Surprised Passerby
steps.text: Am I seeing things... How did the top of the volcano turn white?

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: What are you talking about? I don't see it...

steps.name: Regretful Passerby
steps.text: Siesta... has been wiped out.

steps.name: No Longer Panicked Passerby
steps.text: I think... 'reborn' might be the more appropriate word here.

steps.name: No Longer Panicked Passerby
steps.text: I say we remember this day forevermore... How about we call it the 'Volcano Festival?'

a.text: Sweet peaceful dreams to you each evening ♪
Not a worry, not a sweat ♪
For what's gone is gone, and the future will come ♪
The sun will rise tomorrow, happy days ♪

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: See you, Siesta.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: See you... Siesta

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Don't be sad, Lady Ceylon. Tomorrow is a new day.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Right... tomorrow is a new day.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hey! You ugly-ass sheep...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Keep my vinyls out your stinkin' mouth...! No chewin' my limited edition shirt, either!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Watch that lava! Dammit! Heat degrades a vinyl's sound!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You think this gonna wear out my patience? You got another thing comin'. I'd do this ten thousand years...

spans.text: gonna wear out my patience? You got another thing comin'. I'd do this ten thousand years...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Dolly! I swear, I'ma feed your clones to the wolves...!
